title: Total RNA Extraction from Frozen Placenta Tissue
author: Scott Lindsay-Hewett
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4b9qsr6
materials: Add 200 proof pure ethanol to mir Vana wash buffers as instructed.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and necessary reagents for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Clean workspace, pipettes, and gloves with RNaseZAP.
Prepare a bucket of ice.
Heat nuclease-free water to 95 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Frozen Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve frozen placenta samples from storage and maintain temperature.

substeps.instruction: Pull frozen placenta samples (~150-200 mg each) from -80 °C and place on dry ice until ready to process.

steps.title: Sample Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis of the placenta tissue using a bead beater.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 1 mL of 1.0mm zirconia/silica beads and 700 µL mir Vana Lysis/Binding Buffer to each sample in screw-cap microcentrifuge tubes with integral O-rings (do not use snap-cap tubes unless secured with an adapter).
Exclude as much air as possible to reduce foaming; tubes should be almost full.
Load samples into the Mini-BeadBeater-16 vial holder ring (up to 16 samples).

Secure the vial holder: rotate the ring so the small hole engages the anti-rotation pin, slide it flat on the wiggle mechanism, place the black plastic hold-down cap over the center bolt (ensuring it contacts the aluminum wiggle mechanism), and hand-tighten the black knob firmly.
Run the Mini-BeadBeater-16 for 00:02:00.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate from the beads and tissue debris.

substeps.instruction: Place samples immediately into a pre-chilled microcentrifuge and spin for 00:05:00 at maximum speed.

steps.title: Homogenate Additive Incubation
steps.instruction: Treat the lysate with the mir Vana miRNA Homogenate Additive.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove 500 µL of lysate (avoiding particulates) and dispense into a fresh labeled microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 µL mir Vana miRNA Homogenate Additive (1:10 volume of original lysate) and vortex to mix.
Incubate for 00:10:00 on ice.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Perform phenol-chloroform extraction to isolate RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Acid-Phenol:Chloroform (1:1 volume of original lysate) and vortex for 00:01:00 to homogenize. (Note: Pipette from the lower phenol phase).
Spin for 00:05:00 at maximum speed in a pre-chilled microcentrifuge.
Carefully remove 350 µL of the top aqueous phase and transfer to a fresh labeled microcentrifuge tube, ensuring the interphase or organic phase is not disturbed.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Prepare the RNA for filter cartridge binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 437.5 µL (1.25 volumes) 200 proof pure ethanol to the aqueous phase and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Filter Cartridge Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the mir Vana Filter Cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of the lysate/ethanol mixture to a mir Vana Filter Cartridge (placed in a mir Vana Collection Tube).
Spin at 10000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 seconds in a pre-chilled microcentrifuge.
Discard flow-through and repeat with any remaining lysate/ethanol mixture (do not exceed 700 µL per cartridge or spin above 10000 x g).

steps.title: Wash RNA
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL mir Vana Wash Solution 1 and spin at 10000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 seconds in a pre-chilled microcentrifuge; discard flow-through.
Add 500 µL mir Vana Wash Solution 2/3 and spin at 10000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 seconds in a pre-chilled microcentrifuge; discard flow-through.
Repeat the Wash Solution 2/3 step.
Spin at 10000 x g, 4 °C, for 2 minutes in a pre-chilled microcentrifuge to remove residual Wash Solution.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the filter.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mir Vana Filter Cartridge into a fresh mir Vana Collection Tube.
Add 40 µL pre-heated nuclease-free water to the center of the filter and close the cap.
Incubate for 00:01:00.
Spin for 00:00:30 at maximum speed in a pre-chilled centrifuge to elute RNA.

steps.title: Storage and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Store the RNA and verify its quantity and integrity.

substeps.instruction: Transfer eluate to a low bind microcentrifuge tube and store at -80 °C (minimize freeze/thaw cycles; store a small aliquot separately for QC).
Quantitate RNA using NanoDrop (expected A260/A280 ratio: 1.8-2.1) or Qubit RNA Broad Range Assay.
If repurification is needed, add 1/10th nuclease-free 5M NaCl and 1.38 volumes 200 proof pure ethanol, then repass through a fresh mir Vana Filter Cartridge starting from the binding step.
Assess RNA quality using the RNA 6000 Nano Assay on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (normal RIN score for placenta is >7.0).
